BEFORE WE TALK

Fair questions.
Straight answers.

Is this just another lead-generation service?+

The service covers the full path: demand generation, inquiry capture, immediate first response, qualification, estimate booking, reminders, rescheduling, reactivation, and reporting. The aim is a qualified appointment with a clear next step for your team.

What counts as a qualified estimate?+

We agree on that before launch. Typically it means a project in your service area, for a service you provide, with the right scope and timing, and a prospect who agrees to an estimate. Qualification relies on information the prospect provides; your team confirms site conditions and prepares the quote.

How much does it cost?+

Pilot programs are available. Scope and fees depend on your market, services, and follow-up needs. We discuss the service fee and a separate advertising budget on the fit call, then put the terms in writing before you commit.

Do you guarantee appointments or revenue?+

No. Demand, competition, budget, seasonality, and your sales process affect results. We agree on what to measure and when to review performance. A booked estimate is an opportunity to quote a project, not a guaranteed job.

What do you need from our team?+

Capacity to take on work, a defined service area, access to the relevant accounts, and available estimate times. Your team attends appointments, prepares quotes, and shares outcomes so reporting reflects what happened after booking.

Can this work with our current tools?+

We review your calendar, CRM, website, and lead-handling process on the call. Where practical, we work with what you already use. Any required integrations or changes are agreed as part of the pilot scope.
